sourceFile: 80. TIU L5S3-01 R Report test NG VP damage sub 3 to make again standard - 2026.03.20_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has comparable evidence but misidentifies the primary changed factor and mismatches line-specific Normal controls.
issues: Primary factor should be Test NG VP damage vs Normal, not Normal vs lines.
Line is subgroup context, but draft treats lines as changed conditions.
Line L comparisons use Line R Normal rows instead of Line L Normal rows.
Header-only measurement outcomes are spurious and not final evidence.
Tension and reliability outcomes are missing or weakly cited.
correctionPlan: Set baselineCondition to Normal and changedCondition to Test NG VP damage from Forming.
Move Line R D3-4A and Line L D3-3A into subgroupKeys.
Pair Line R Test with row 20 and Line L Test with row 24 for bonding.
Pair Line R Test with row 31 and Line L Test with row 35 for function.
Add tension rows 41-44 and cite actual reliability rows if available; remove header-only stats.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist but are insufficient because key pairings and outcome evidence are incorrect.
